name: Walker
slug: Walker is a half-elf dragon rider and fighter bonded to Glimmen, originally from La-rel and now Gatekeeper of The Reach.
description: Half-elf dragon rider and fighter, bonded to the mind-linked dragon Glimmen. Walker is originally from La-rel and is the only party member known to have come from outside Midgard. He is now the Gatekeeper of The Reach, responsible for protecting and exploring the largest Arch, a role well suited to him and Glimmen because of their ability to fly.

log.summary:
Edit

Walker joins Gerk in taking on his new responsibility out of loyalty and friendship, despite initially not understanding the significance of the Great Tree. He considers Glimmen part of the group and jokingly argues that she deserves a crown. As the only party member originally from outside Midgard, Walker is offered the La-rel keystone but declines it, choosing The Reach instead because La-rel represents his past while The Reach better reflects who he has become. He receives The Reach keystone and becomes its Gatekeeper, taking responsibility for protecting and exploring the largest Arch. Walker and Glimmen are particularly well suited to traveling the Reach due to their ability to fly. He is also able to see the mysterious white-flower girl and her trail, and recognizes a distinctive tree after Gerk opens a portal to a forest, helping identify the location as being near Langdale. Walker is eager to use the portal to travel back toward home. The Raven Queen notes that Walker and Ord have impressed her less than some of the others, though they have still demonstrated qualities beyond what she normally sees in mortals.

log.summary: Walker plans to return to The Reach with Glimmen, Plymouth Gawater, Elrus, and Araden to scout the Dragon Rider training grounds for clues related to his vision of Grixto and Galixtar near the caves. He intends to keep Elrus and Araden as secret weapons, carry the party's sending stone for updates, recharge his gems, and retreat if necessary rather than seek a fight. Walker uses his keystone to activate the gate to The Reach, despite its portal's size being insufficient to bring the party's boat through. He notes that his former roost appears empty and that he previously explored the area without encountering Grixto. He also recognizes that The Reach's time difference may allow him to spend much longer there than the party experiences in Midgard. Walker describes The Reach as an autumnal setting with crisp weather, early fall colors, and the National Flying League beginning its season, alongside floating jack-o'-lanterns and other flying elements.
